description.value: Blaze Gourmet Burgers began as a COVID-era ghost kitchen in 2019 and grew into a multi-location brand anchored in Vancouver's Mount Pleasant neighbourhood. The restaurant is built around dietary inclusivity, offering certified Angus beef burgers alongside a full range of vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, and halal options — including vegan poutine and vegan chicken strips. The Mount Pleasant flagship also houses Blaze Cafe, a sister company serving premium Indonesian-sourced coffee, making it a capable one-stop for a cyclist wanting both a substantial meal and a quality coffee.
